session-tools.thisSessionChangedWhileEdi: This session changed while editing. The name draft is retained; cancel and reopen before saving.
session-tools.retryPreparationUsingThisS: Retry preparation using this session's original workspace selection. Normal server dispatch eligibility applies after successful preparation.
session-tools.allowTheOwningWorkerToClea: Allow the owning Worker to clean only incomplete managed preparation from the original operation. Ready content and original Local checkouts are preserved. Successful recovery remains paused.
session-tools.inspectTheOriginalExecutio: Inspect the original execution's retained Worker report and startup or native cleanup evidence. This does not resend input or resume execution; missing proof remains a recovery problem.
session-tools.inspectTheOriginalPreparat: Inspect the original preparation without permitting incomplete-workspace cleanup. Successful recovery remains paused until an explicit Resume.

session-tools.operationAcceptedItsWorker: Operation accepted. Its Worker result and cleanup remain separate; follow the retained operation below.
